(5) Card count: exactly ONE season-manage card renders today, scoped to `manageableSeasonId` (the single 'admin's pick' season per #167 — current-if-running else soonest future), never one-per-season. The only `{#each seasons as season}` loop in the whole file is at :7370-7372, and it is a plain `<option>` list inside the season-scoped `<select data-testid="event-create-season">` dropdown in the event-create form — unrelated to card rendering. `SeasonSummary` (imported :102, used :7814) is a separate attendance-rate widget for the viewer's current season, not a season-manage card and not a list. findings.claim: (6) #245-era in-situ field editing / panel-internals boundary: the panel div (`id="season-manage-panel"`, :5978-7118) contains, as its own children, three whole-field editors (name :6000-6052, start_date :6069-6118ish, end_date similarly following) each with its own `seasonEditingField`-gated input-vs-button branch, `beginSeasonFieldEdit`/`confirmSeasonFieldEdit`/`handleSeasonFieldKeydown` handlers (referenced :6037, :6010-6011, not fully read this turn) plus conductor picker, series list (`{#each seasonManageSeries}` :6691), events list (`{#each seasonManageEvents}` :6832), and the panel's own repertoire section (`RepertoireElement` :7104-7116). The title row's collapse-toggle and trashcan additions therefore have a clean structural boundary: they attach to the toolbar div and its `handleAdminToolbarKeydown`/`toolbarActiveTestid` roving scheme, while every #245-era field-editing handler (`beginSeasonFieldEdit`, `confirmSeasonFieldEdit`, `handleSeasonFieldKeydown`, `focusSeasonInputOnMount`) lives and fires entirely within the panel's own `onkeydown={onSeasonManagePanelKeydown}` scope, with no shared DOM ancestor closer than `agenda-admin-card` itself.

risks: This is a read-only architectural map for a PLANNING deliverable, not a verified end-to-end audit: several referenced helper functions (rovingNextIndex, beginSeasonFieldEdit, confirmSeasonFieldEdit, handleSeasonFieldKeydown, focusSeasonInputOnMount, apiCountSeasonScope, apiDeleteSeason) were located by name/reference but their FULL bodies were not read this turn — their exact behavior is [unverified] beyond what the surrounding comments and call sites show.

The end_date field editor block, the conductor-picker markup (:6120-6280ish), and the series/events list rows (:6691-6910ish) were not read in full this turn — only their opening lines and gating conditions were sampled; any per-row delete-armed state (`seasonManageDeleteArmed === series.id` / `=== event.id`, seen at :6726 and :6867 via grep) reuses the SAME `seasonManageDeleteArmed` slot as the season-level delete, which the code comments describe as deliberate ('arming one disarms the other') — this single-slot design is a real constraint on any multi-card redesign (N cards each wanting independent armed-delete state) but was not fully traced.

No live app/browser check was performed (no `run` skill invocation) — this map is derived entirely from static reading of src/routes/+page.svelte; the actual rendered DOM/behavior in a browser was not observed this session, so anything about visual layout (e.g., exact right-alignment/wrapping under `flex-wrap`) is inferred from Tailwind classes, not screenshotted.

The multi-season-card architecture gap (finding 5) is the largest scope risk: today's entire season-manage state model (seasonManageOpen, seasonManageDeleteArmed, seasonManageDeleteProgress, seasonManageSeries, seasonManageEvents, panelRepertoire, etc. — all page-level $state scalars/arrays) assumes ONE manageable season. If the eventual build genuinely needs one card per season (contract language 'cards sit below it' is plural), most of this state needs to become keyed-by-season-id rather than singular, which is a much larger change than the four visible contract rules alone suggest — worth flagging to Gama/PO before scoping the implementation slice.

findings.evidence: src/routes/page.agenda-admin.spec.ts:1083-1134, the describe 'the season trashcan paints red (SVG on currentColor)' — none of its assertions (svg count, data-icon="trash", currentColor, no emoji, text-red-700/hover:text-red-800, min-h-11/min-w-11, aria-label) depend on the trashcan's parent being the toolbar/card-header vs the opened title row.

findings.claim: Rights tier (axis 5) is verified exactly: the card/gear render gate is `manageableSeasonId !== null && manageableSeasonRights === 'editor'`, where ManageRightsState is a 3-value union `'editor' | 'not-editor' | 'error'` (fail-closed on both 'not-editor' and 'error'). A non-editor (member) gets ZERO admin controls — not hidden, not disabled, absent from the DOM — confirmed by an explicit spec ('NON-editor... EVERY admin control is absent from the DOM — not hidden, not disabled').
findings.evidence: src/routes/+page.svelte:2463-2465 (`const showSeasonManageGear = $derived(manageableSeasonId !== null && manageableSeasonRights === 'editor');`); src/lib/repertoire/types.ts:28 (`export type ManageRightsState = 'editor' | 'not-editor' | 'error';`); src/routes/page.agenda-admin.spec.ts:1191-1200 and :746-755 (non-editor gets no toolbar/card at all, not an empty frame).

findings.claim: The zero-seasons MEMBER (non-editor) empty state is a SEPARATE code path (`agenda-empty`) from the admin onboarding banner (`agenda-onboarding`), and is explicitly pinned to stay untouched: 'agenda-onboarding is ABSENT for a non-editor — the existing generic empty state stays', asserting `agenda-empty` renders instead. This means the #261 rework's '+ Hooaeg is the ONLY control with zero seasons' claim applies ONLY to the editor-gated onboarding surface, not to what members see — the member zero-seasons empty state is out of this rework's blast radius by the existing gate design, and should NOT regress as a side effect.
findings.evidence: src/routes/page.agenda-onboarding.spec.ts:260-270 (test body, read this turn: `loadFullAgendaMock.mockResolvedValue(agendaResult({editor:false}))` then `expect(q(container,'agenda-empty')).not.toBeNull()`, `expect(q(container,'agenda-onboarding')).toBeNull()`).

findings.claim: i18n (axis 6): `season_manage_gear_label` (en 'Manage season' / et 'Halda hooaega' / lv 'Pārvaldīt sezonu' / uk 'Керувати сезоном') and `agenda_admin_toolbar_label` (en 'Season and event actions' / et 'Hooaja ja sündmuse tegevused' / lv 'Sezonas un pasākuma darbības' / uk 'Дії із сезоном та подією') are each present in all 4 locale files, but BOTH keys lose their only consumer under #261 (the gear's aria-label; the retired `role="toolbar"` element's aria-label) and become dead keys needing removal in all 4 locales — the same discipline #236 already applied once to the sibling dead key `season_manage_panel_label` (removed from all 4 locales, pinned by its own describe).
findings.evidence: messages/{en,et,lv,uk}.json lines ~17-21 and ~385-401 read this turn (agenda_admin_toolbar_label, season_manage_gear_label present in all 4); src/routes/+page.svelte:5760 (`aria-label={m.agenda_admin_toolbar_label()}` on the toolbar div) and :5930 (`aria-label={m.season_manage_gear_label()}` on the gear) — both elements are removed by the rework; src/routes/page.agenda-admin.spec.ts:1165-1177 shows the precedent test shape for asserting a dead key's removal across all 4 locales (used for `season_manage_panel_label` under #236).

findings.claim: The rework needs at minimum two NEW accessible-name keys per locale that do not exist yet: an accessible name for the collapsed card's expand action (whole card is a click target, needs an aria-label or equivalent naming what expanding does, analogous to the retired gear label) and for the opened card's title-row collapse action — neither key exists under any obviously-matching name in the locale files.
findings.evidence: grep across messages/en.json for `season_manage_expand\|season_manage_collapse\|season_card` returned no matches (checked en.json content directly at lines 385-440 read this turn — no such keys present); the existing `season_manage_gear_label` copy ('Manage season'/'Halda hooaega') is the closest analogue but is scoped to a control (the gear) that no longer exists, so it cannot simply be repointed without a copy/semantics decision (does the collapsed card's accessible name say 'expand' vs. reuse 'manage'?).

findings.claim: Multi-collective races (axis 7): the season-manage/delete-cascade code ALREADY carries generation/collective-switch guards that the rework must preserve, not newly invent — e.g. a scope read in flight when the operator switches collective never lands in the new collective's confirm (spec at page.season-manage-delete.spec.ts:1295-1356), and a cascade completing after a collective switch reloads nothing and announces nothing (line 1481-1572). These are EXISTING protections, verified present in the current code/spec, not gaps #261 introduces — but the rework adds a NEW piece of local state (card expanded/collapsed) that has no such guard yet designed, since it does not exist before this issue.
findings.evidence: src/routes/page.season-manage-delete.spec.ts:1295-1356 ('a scope read still in flight when the operator switches collective never lands in the NEW collective's confirm') and :1481-1525 ('a collective switch mid-cascade clears the counter — and a late tick from the abandoned run never resurrects it'); src/routes/+page.svelte:2741 `function resetSeasonManage(...)` already resets `seasonManageOpen` and related panel state on every collective switch (per its own doc comment at :2568, :2618-2624).

findings.claim: A new 'season card expanded/collapsed' boolean (or equivalent) that the rework must introduce does not yet exist in the codebase under any name, so whether it needs to reset to collapsed on a collective switch (mirroring `resetSeasonManage`'s existing reset of `seasonManageOpen`) is an open design question the rework must answer, not something already covered by a spec.
findings.evidence: grep of src/routes/+page.svelte for `seasonCardExpanded\|cardExpanded\|seasonCardOpen` (informal search while reading lines 2445-3000 and 4680-4760) found no such state — only `seasonManageOpen` (the PANEL's open state, separate from the proposed collapsed/expanded CARD state the ruling introduces).

findings.claim: Touch targets (axis 8): the existing 44x44 (min-h-11/min-w-11) discipline is already pinned for the trashcan itself and for [+Season]/gear, in a dedicated describe. The NEW target this rework must add — the whole-collapsed-card click area and the opened title-row click area — has a direct precedent pattern already used elsewhere in the same file for a similar 'whole element is the click target' shape (the #205 season-name inline-edit button), which wraps its content in a real `<button>` with `min-h-11 w-full` rather than sizing an icon alone.
findings.evidence: src/routes/page.agenda-admin.spec.ts:1983-2000 (44x44 describe, page-level entry points including the trashcan `iconOnly:true`); src/routes/+page.svelte:6015-6039 (the #205 whole-field pattern comment and its `<button>` implementation: `class="group flex min-h-11 w-full appearance-none items-center gap-2 ..."`) — directly reusable precedent for making the whole collapsed card (and the opened title row) a real `<button>`-or-equivalent native, full-width, min-h-11 click target rather than a styled div with a click handler.

findings.claim: Native-controls axis (9): nothing in the current season-manage-card DOM uses a custom widget that the rework's collapse/expand mechanism would need to reproduce — the existing season-name/date inline-edit fields already use plain native `<input>`+`<button>` pairs (#205 pattern), and person-pickers elsewhere on the page are already native `<select>` per the #209 retirement of the old Autocomplete. No evidence found of any non-native control inside the header row or panel that the rework's re-render would newly need to convert.
findings.evidence: src/routes/+page.svelte:6002-6039 (name field: native `<input>`/`<button>`); src/routes/page.agenda-admin.spec.ts:64-70 ('#209 retired the Autocomplete... every person picker is a native <select> now') — read as file-header commentary, not independently re-verified against the conductor-select markup this turn beyond the earlier grep at page.agenda-admin.spec.ts:445-454 (`scope.querySelector('select[data-testid$="-conductor-select"]')`).

risks: Focus-management redesign is undecided: closing the panel currently returns focus to `season-manage-gear` (pinned in 2 places in page.season-manage.spec.ts and referenced in page.season-manage-delete.spec.ts:1785 for the Escape-while-armed case via `closeSeasonManagePanel()`'s existing tail `seasonManageGearEl?.focus()`). With the gear deleted, the rework must pick a new focus-return target (the title row? the collapsed card?) — this is a real design decision, not a mechanical rename, and every spec asserting `document.activeElement === gear` needs a coordinated update to whatever that decision becomes.

The armed confirm/cancel pair currently roves as toolbar members alongside season-create and the gear (page.season-manage-delete.spec.ts:1788-1799, page.agenda-admin.spec.ts:2207-2321). Once season-create leaves the card and the gear is deleted, the opened title row likely holds only the trashcan (or, while armed, only confirm/cancel) — the roving-tabindex/role="toolbar" pattern may become degenerate (arity 1) and should probably be retired in favor of plain tab order, per the same 'arity 2 is not degenerate, arity 1 would be' reasoning the code's own #213 SPIKE-finding comment already used to justify keeping vs. dropping the pattern at a given arity — this is a judgment call the rework needs to make explicitly, not inherit silently.

No spec or code currently defines an accessible name for the proposed collapsed-card expand affordance or the opened-card title-row collapse affordance; two new i18n keys (all 4 locales) are needed and their exact copy is a product decision, not inferable from existing strings.

Whether the proposed card-expanded/collapsed boolean needs a collective-switch reset (mirroring `resetSeasonManage`'s handling of `seasonManageOpen`) is unresolved — the state does not exist yet, so no existing test proves or disproves a race here; recommend adding a generation-guard-style reset alongside `resetSeasonManage` when the state is introduced, by analogy with the existing `seasonManageOpen`/cascade-generation guards.

PO's own ruling comment flags its two 'PO reading, correctable at live review' points (cascade counter visible while collapsed; armed confirm/cancel placement) as NOT yet confirmed by Mihkel directly — implementation should be reviewable/adjustable at the live gate per the ruling's own framing, not treated as final until his live review.

#237 (red-trashcan icon-sweep) is explicitly named in #261's ruling as unblocked-but-still-unready ('needs-po/unready') — do not fold it into this rework's scope even though it touches the same TrashIcon component.

This review is read-only per the repo guard; no attempt was made to run the test suite, so all 'flips/extends/stays' classifications are inferred from static reading of specs and source, not from actually running RED tests against a prototype implementation — treat the mechanical blast-radius list as a starting map for TDD RED, not as a substitute for writing the new failing tests.
